Header.featureAiMenuManagerDesc: Update your menu by message, with approval cards.
Header.featureBusinessHealthDesc: AI health check for your menu.

Faq.q12: Does AI Menu Manager change my menu automatically?
Faq.a12: No. AI Menu Manager prepares cards. Important work such as prices, bulk updates, publishing, and generated images needs owner approval before it goes live.
Faq.q13: Is AI Menu Manager a customer chatbot?
Faq.a13: No. It is an owner-side menu operations feature. Customers do not chat with it. Owners use it to prepare menu updates inside MenuList.
Faq.q14: Can staff use AI Menu Manager?
Faq.a14: Staff access depends on the permissions the owner gives them. High-risk work still follows approval rules and cannot bypass owner-controlled access.
Faq.q15: Can it update Zomato, Swiggy, Google, or Instagram directly?
Faq.a15: Only when a supported first-party adapter exists. Otherwise MenuList prepares a manual task, export, or copy/share card so the external step is clear.

Pricing.decision2Desc: Starter covers simple publishing. Pro adds AI Menu Manager, stronger presentation, and owner controls. Premium supports location governance.
Pricing.proReinforcementAdvice: Starter is enough for one current public menu. Choose Pro when AI Menu Manager, presentation, languages, and owner controls matter.

HowItWorks.step4Subtitle: Change a price, mark an item sold out, add a special, update a photo, or publish a new version from a simple message. AI Menu Manager prepares the card, shows what customers will see, and waits for approval before applying important work.
HowItWorks.step4P0: Price changes show old price, new price, selected project, and approval before update
HowItWorks.step4P1: Sold-out and availability changes show the customer-facing state before they apply
HowItWorks.step4P2: Specials, photos, design, imports, and publishing stay card-based and reviewable
HowItWorks.step4P3: Approved work uses existing MenuList save, publish, and cache paths

AiMenuManagerHome.title: Your approved menu now updates like a message.

AiMenuManagerPage.heroSubtitle: AI Menu Manager is an approval-based AI agent for menu operations. Update prices, sold-out items, specials, photos, imports, design, and publishing from simple messages while MenuList keeps you in control.
AiMenuManagerPage.agentSubtitle: AI card prepared from your selected menu

AiMenuManagerPage.flowTitle: Message in. Card prepared. Approval first. Receipt after.
AiMenuManagerPage.flowSubtitle: AI can understand the owner request, but registered MenuList actions control what can be prepared and what can be applied.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow0Desc: The owner types or speaks a menu change in normal language.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow1Desc: MenuList shows the item, scope, before and after state, and customer-facing impact.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow2Desc: Prices, bulk work, publishing, generated images, and risky changes wait for approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.flow3Desc: Approved work uses the existing MenuList save, import, image, publish, cache, and receipt paths.
AiMenuManagerPage.commandsSubtitle: These examples stay grounded in the selected store and project. All-project or multi-outlet work is shown before approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.demo0Output: Price card with old price, new price, and approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.demo2Output: Special item card with placement and expiry.
AiMenuManagerPage.demo3Output: Design card using existing MenuList theme controls.
AiMenuManagerPage.demo4Output: Draft image card. Owner chooses whether to use it.
AiMenuManagerPage.demo5Output: Manual task or export card unless a supported adapter exists.
AiMenuManagerPage.opsTitle: Built for menu work, not random chat.
AiMenuManagerPage.opsSubtitle: Every executable request maps to a registered MenuList action type. Unsupported external work becomes a clear manual task, not a fake done state.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops0Desc: Prepare single-item or bulk price, sold-out, visibility, and status cards from the selected menu.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops1Desc: Prepare today specials, banners, special menus, and publishing work with the right approval level.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops2Desc: Generate drafts and apply them only after the owner chooses to use them on the menu.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops3Desc: Use existing menu import and extraction review paths instead of overwriting live menu data.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops4Desc: Turn style requests into previewable changes using MenuList design controls.
AiMenuManagerPage.ops5Desc: Zomato, Swiggy, Google, Instagram, and similar destinations stay manual unless a real supported adapter exists.
AiMenuManagerPage.safetyTitle: AI prepares the work. You stay in control.
AiMenuManagerPage.safetySubtitle: The feature is designed around approval, selected store/project context, and receipts so important menu truth does not change silently.
AiMenuManagerPage.safety0Desc: Price changes, bulk updates, publishing, generated images, and risky work require explicit owner approval.
AiMenuManagerPage.safety1Desc: Approved work uses existing MenuList save, image, import, publish, cache, and receipt behavior.
AiMenuManagerPage.safety2Desc: Unsupported external posting is shown honestly as a manual step or export handoff.
AiMenuManagerPage.finalSubtitle: Create the official menu once. Then keep it current by telling MenuList what changed.

Features.group4F0Desc: Update prices, sold-out items, photos, specials, imports, design, and publishing from simple messages. MenuList prepares the card and waits for approval before important changes go live.
Features.group4F1Desc: AI health checks for your menu and public presence. Business Health shows what needs attention, says No action needed when stable, and hands fixes to AI Menu Manager or existing owner screens.
Features.group4F2Desc: Activate a festival or event menu with a scheduled automatic switch-back. You set it once — it reverts itself.
Features.group4F3Desc: Closed today? Opening late? Add a time-bound banner that disappears when it is no longer needed.
Features.group4F4Desc: Run outlets from one master menu. Publish approved changes through the location system, with local override capability.
Features.group4F5Desc: A simple status checklist shows where your menu is visible — Google, Instagram, WhatsApp, QR, screens — and which surfaces still need setup.
Features.group4F6Desc: Pre-written messages for "Send menu", "Where are you?", and "Are you open?" — with your link, address, and hours included. One tap to copy and send.
Features.group4F7Desc: Bulk operations for pricing, availability, categories, and status. Select multiple items and apply changes in one action — with full preview before applying.
Features.group4F8Desc: For connected systems, approved menu changes can send a signed full-menu snapshot after publish.
Features.group4F9Desc: Use MenuList from a phone browser or installed PWA to edit menus, publish changes, share QR/link assets, review feedback, check Business Health, manage screens, adjust key settings, and handle daily operations without waiting for a desktop.
Features.group4F10Desc: Add staff with email or Staff ID and passcode, choose what each role can access, reset passcodes, and sign out old sessions when staff changes.
Features.group4F11Desc: Customers can report wrong prices, missing items, outdated details, or service concerns from the public view. You review it privately and correct the approved source.
Features.group4F12Desc: Owner workspace language preference, timezone, date format, and time format stay together. Customer-facing menu languages remain tied to the approved source.

BusinessHealth.title: Business Health is your AI health check.
BusinessHealth.subtitle: After publishing, MenuList checks the latest menu state, public surfaces, customer attention, and locations. It shows what needs attention, and stable checks say No action needed.
BusinessHealth.panelMessage: MenuList did not find anything that needs action in the latest check.
BusinessHealth.panelFreshness: Uses data through the last settled business day.
BusinessHealth.answerText: Answers stay grounded in cached MenuList data with source freshness.
BusinessHealth.proof0Desc: The dashboard opens with status, freshness, and whether anything needs attention.
BusinessHealth.proof1Desc: Standard periods such as today, this week, last month, and overall come from cached summaries.
BusinessHealth.proof2Desc: When a change is needed, Business Health points to AI Menu Manager or the existing owner screen instead of changing public truth by itself.
BusinessHealth.proof3Desc: The same Business Health view appears inside the mobile owner app.
BusinessHealth.caption: Business Health is the AI diagnostic layer. AI Menu Manager is the approved action layer.

BusinessHealthFeature.heroTitle: AI health checks for your menu.
BusinessHealthFeature.heroSubtitle: Business Health checks the latest MenuList facts: menu state, public surfaces, customer attention, locations, and freshness. It shows what needs attention and keeps real changes inside approved AI Menu Manager or owner-screen flows.
BusinessHealthFeature.previewBody: MenuList did not find anything that needs action in the latest check.
BusinessHealthFeature.previewAnswer: Business Health answers from cached MenuList data and shows the freshness of the check.
BusinessHealthFeature.storyEyebrow: From AI check to approved fix
BusinessHealthFeature.storyTitle: Business Health finds issues. AI Menu Manager prepares fixes.
BusinessHealthFeature.storySubtitle: The page stays diagnostic: what MenuList checked, what the owner should know, and where an approved fix should happen.
BusinessHealthFeature.storyChecksSummary: Latest state, public surfaces, customer attention, and location state.
BusinessHealthFeature.storyOutcomesSummary: A calm daily check instead of another dashboard to interpret.
BusinessHealthFeature.storyOutcomesDesc: Business Health turns the latest MenuList state into the short owner-facing result that matters.
BusinessHealthFeature.storyTrustSummary: Cached facts, existing owner flows, and desktop/mobile parity.
BusinessHealthFeature.checksTitle: The owner sees the business state, not raw tables.
BusinessHealthFeature.checksSubtitle: Business Health is built around the information an owner actually needs when opening MenuList.
BusinessHealthFeature.check0Desc: The dashboard starts with the latest known state and shows whether anything needs attention.
BusinessHealthFeature.check1Desc: Menu, links, QR, screens, and official business surfaces stay tied to the owner-approved source.
BusinessHealthFeature.check2Desc: Standard periods show customer signals such as top items and recent attention without forcing owners into spreadsheets.
BusinessHealthFeature.check3Desc: Multi-location owners can see compact outlet state first, then open the outlet that needs checking.
BusinessHealthFeature.outcomesTitle: A calm daily check for the business.
BusinessHealthFeature.outcome0Desc: When the latest check is stable, the owner sees No action needed instead of another task list.
BusinessHealthFeature.outcome1Desc: Business Health shows the last checked date so owners do not mistake settled data for live realtime data.
BusinessHealthFeature.outcome2Desc: When something needs work, Business Health opens AI Menu Manager or the existing owner screen instead of changing the menu itself.
BusinessHealthFeature.trustTitle: AI diagnosis stays inside MenuList truth.
BusinessHealthFeature.trustSubtitle: The page reduces owner work while staying grounded in the MenuList data that is actually available.
BusinessHealthFeature.trust0Desc: Business Health can point to a fix, but menu, store, outlet, and public changes stay in approved AI Menu Manager, editor, settings, and publish flows.
BusinessHealthFeature.trust1Desc: Business Health reads compact summaries and cached packets instead of scanning raw Firebase data for every question.
BusinessHealthFeature.trust2Desc: The same owner-facing Business Health view is available from the desktop dashboard and mobile owner app.
BusinessHealthFeature.finalTitle: Know the issue before customers notice.
BusinessHealthFeature.finalSubtitle: Business Health gives MenuList an AI-era diagnostic hook without making the product autonomous: it checks, explains, and hands fixes to approved flows.
